lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; i1040gi (2025) Tax Table and Tax Computation Worksheet SectionsA-D use the$100,000 split. The returned tax selector makes that same split and uses the same filing-status row rates/subtractions above it. Its status-specific worksheet helpers also return Tax Table amounts below$100,000, but those extra helper branches are never selected by tax in that range; the outer tax selector already uses the Tax Table. All admitted final tax results therefore use the same source computations. No identical standalone behavior is claimed for unselected worksheet helpers.
